title: Buyer-specific price lists (assigned to an Account or User Profile)
summary: A price list holding special prices can be associated with a B2B Account or a User Profile; Znode's precedence rules decide the price shown on the storefront and used at checkout. Configuration only, no code.
when_to_use: special or contract pricing for a customer group modelled as an Account or a User Profile
time-limited prices (activation and expiration dates on the list)
not_for: a percentage rule over the whole catalog without maintaining prices (consider a profile-scoped promotion, which is cart-time)
a group that is neither an Account nor a Profile

contract.admin_path: OMS > Pricing Lists (as read in the pricing skill; confirm in the Admin version in use)
contract.precedence: a lower precedence number wins; resolution order per the pricing skill: user, account, profile, store (skill only, 50-70%)

evidence.note: buyer-specific lists linked to Accounts and User Profiles; precedence decides the displayed and checkout price

limitations: Child accounts do not inherit a parent's price lists (pricing skill only; verify)
One price per SKU: a rule like '10% off everything' means maintaining the list
Not verified live on an environment

unverified: Admin steps and menu names on the customer's Znode version
behaviour with tier and sale prices together
